nom: Origins Youthtopia Liquid Exfoliating Apple Face Peel

avis.texte: This is the best smelling product I've ever put on my face. I use this before I want to wear makeup for special occasions. Just spread it onto my hands and fingers, rub it into my skin where I need the most help (usually my t zone) and it clears up my sebaceous filaments instantly for smoother makeup application. I haven't tried to use it regularly, and I don't know the percentage of the actives so I'm cautious to. Other than that, I love this product so much. Please don't change the scent. It's mouth watering.
Love the results this product is giving my skin! Thanks to the Ulta consultant who steered me in the right direction.

I am so impressed with this product. I haven't found a good serum for my skin, and moisturizers are too oily and heavy for my skin type (I have combo skin while also being slightly sensitive), and this is a perfect "in between" for those. I stumbled upon this in Ulta after looking through multiple other brands and products, did some quick research, and took a chance on it- and I'm so glad I did! I'm 32 years old and I don't wear a lot of foundation on my skin, so I really try to even my skin tone however I can with products, and this is AMAZING. It smells so good (I saw some reviews about it smelling bad? Idk what that was about, it smells great- like a small apple smell), it's gentle on my skin while also feeling like it's helping it as a peel, and my skin is so soft and smooth. I am so impressed, and will be using this forever going forward. I can't recommend it enough!

I saw lots of reviews about the smell of this product, and I can only assume those customers received a bad batch. There is a mild smell but not at all intolerable as described. I used this product last night and it works well and smells good to me. The only time I was able to smell it on my face was when I curled my top to touch my nose. I like both products, as I do just about all other Origins products. Thanks for all you do!
I ordered it to try and honestly felt it didn't do anything. I felt nothing, saw nothing and overall was very unimpressed. I hope I can return it for a refund.
Can I use my vitamin C serum with this? I've used this peel a few times a week for a couple of weeks and so far I really like it. My skin feels smoother and my redness seems to be fading a little.

I've used origins years ago and really like their skincare but the apple peel toner was not something I would ever buy again. Surely this sis not for everyone and it definitely was not for me….. claims it give a nice bounce and glow to skin and it did not do that to mine, it actually did the opposite!!!!! Was highly disappointed because I truly wanted to love this product! The smell was also very, very overwhelming it gave me a severe headache and that because I've had scented things before but this smell was way too powerful made my stomach turn!!! 🤢 would not purchase this again and would not recommend to anyone who is sensitive to smell. N9 origins! Very bad!!!

This refining peel works just as described: it decreases dullness and refines pores. I use it morning and night after cleaning but before serum. I also use the Youthtopia moisturizer and have to say that I love these products!!!!
This had my cheeks so dry and peeling...I have never experienced anything like this. I would not recommend this

avis.titre: This appears to make a true difference in my skincare
avis.texte: I am 54 and enjoy hiking and a natural look for beauty and skincare. I've been applying this product in the evening after cleansing with "Checks and Balances" wash. After that I have been going back and forth between a light retinol cream or a basic simple cream moisturizer, or sometimes the Origins ginger line of creams. Anyway it seems to me that this Youthtopia actually makes a big difference for how my skin looks the next morning. Regardless of which cream I use, the main difference seems to be this. What I see is healthier skin because it looks less tired and more hydrated. Hard to say "plump" but to me that means my deeper 50 year old wrinkles are less visible and my overall look is refreshed. When I apply this, I feel nothing and there is no immediate change. But the next morning, day after day, I can see a benefit. I know they are not the same thing but if I had to choose between my retinol cream and Youthtopia, I would keep my Youthtopia. Now that some time has gone by, I am interested in trying the other products similar to this one.

avis.titre: I have found a great product line
avis.texte: It is seldom that I take the time to write a review. But I have to say the youth Topia apple peel and the apple cream are probably the best products I have purchased in a long time. I've purchased a lot of origins products but this one. I'm not kidding, gave me noticeably difference in the texture and the clarity and evened out of my complexion. So pleased. I purchased the product when they were running a special on it because it was new. Glad I did.
Unsure of how I like the product just yet but it does have an odd, strong smell. I wish they would change the bottle, you end up spilling product. It needs a dispenser cap.

avis.titre: Smells bad but not as bad as the lotion
avis.texte: I would not recommend this product - this is not as bad as the cream (which smells awful) but not what you would expect from Origins. I got sick from the smell everytime I attempted to use it.
Very dissappointed. It's basically overpriced toner in a bottle. The bottle is not spill proof.

decided to try this apple peel. I'm on week#1so far: skin becomes slightly pink after applying it I guess that's the exfoliation working, scent is not pleasant but fades away quickly(probably the worst scent of all Origins products and I've been using Origins for a long time) Instructions are not clear as to what do I use after applying this peel, do I follow up with a toner or use serum/and moisturizer? we'll see, I'll update my review after I finish the bottle
Youthtopia apple peel smells so good and it redefined my facial smoothness. Highly recommend this product!!!
This is the worst products I bought from ORIGINS. Smells really BAD and I don't notice any effects. I am returning this. It says peel, but you can't peel it.

This peel does the trick, quickly and without irritating my skin. It smells pleasant. It's easy to apply on my face. You can feel the peel working but it's not harsh. Leave it on, apply moisturizer and make-up (or not) and have a healthy glow all day.

I was really excited about this product and enjoy the face cream in this line, but this product has a distressing smell. It gave me a headache it was so strong. I hope they can reproduce without the artificial fragrance, because I would love to give this product a proper try.

I have always loved origins it was one of the first brands I ever tried on my skin. Therefore I always trust them when it comes to skin care. I was a little nervous because my skin is very sensitive but it did not disappoint. I applied it at night and the next morning my skin was plump and looked more firm. I have been loving the results.

I was so excited to try this product and see the difference in my skin. I was blown away with how exfoliated it left my skin feeling without drying or irradiated. So happy to be adding this to my routine.

Since I don't have sensitive skin, my skin responded well to this formula. It's a gentle exfoliant with potent ingredients.The gentle exfoliant helped to remove dead skin cells, leaving my skin looking brighter and smoother.

avis.titre: Milky Way to a Smooth Texture
avis.texte: Pleasantly surprised with exfoliating and nourishing properties of this milky liquid formulated with apple peels. It's gentle, yet powerful, in providing smooth texture. My combination skin feels rejuvenated after using it for a few weeks.

I recently had the pleasure of trying out the new Origins YOUTHTOPIA™ Liquid Exfoliating Apple Face Peel, and I must say, it has quickly become a standout in my skincare routine! First Impressions: The packaging is sleek and modern, which immediately caught my eye. The fresh apple scent is invigorating and adds a delightful sensory experience to my skincare regimen. Application: The liquid formula is incredibly easy to apply. I love how it glides smoothly onto my skin, providing an even application without any hassle. It absorbed quickly, leaving no sticky residue, which is a huge plus. Results: After using the peel a few times, I noticed a significant improvement in the texture and radiance of my skin. My complexion appears brighter and more even-toned. The exfoliating properties work gently yet effectively, removing dead skin cells and revealing a fresh, youthful glow. Ingredients: One of the highlights for me is the blend of natural ingredients. The apple extract, combined with other botanicals, ensures that my skin feels nourished and cared for without any harsh side effects. It's great for all skin types, even sensitive skin like mine. Final Thoughts: Overall, the Origins YOUTHTOPIA™ Liquid Exfoliating Apple Face Peel has exceeded my expectations. It's a fantastic addition to any skincare routine for those looking to achieve smooth, radiant skin. I highly recommend giving it a try if you're seeking an effective, gentle exfoliating treatment that delivers visible results.

smells very apple-y. the bottle seems cool! just apply, and the liquid absorbs quickly without any stickiness. It gently exfoliates, getting rid of dead skin cells and revealing a brighter, more radiant complexion. If you're looking for something to increase your exfoliation game you could try a peel.

avis.titre: All of my girls loved this!
avis.texte: Took this to a girls night and we all tried it out and every single girl (all skin types and ages) loved it! It was such a good peel and refreshed our skin so much. I would recommend this for all skin types! 10/10

I was due for a good face peel and this one did the job. I have sensitive skin and it didn't irritate my face. I really love it and will part of my nighttime routine. I've noticed a smoother skin immediately.

The Youthtopia Exfoliating Apple Face Peel from Origins is gentle and effective. It was simple and enjoyable to use, and after a few weeks, I observed a noticeable improvement in my skin's appearance. I appreciate when products deliver on their promises, and this one certainly did. I will recommend it and will definitely continue to use it regularly.

avis.titre: Part of my regular skin care routine
avis.texte: This face peel from The Origins has been great for the evenness of my skin. I feel like I noticed such a difference in my skin texture. I love the sweet and subtle scent. This review was incentivized.

I've been using Origin's YOUTHTOPIA™ Liquid Exfoliating Apple Face Peel for a few weeks now, and I'm really impressed. My skin feels smoother and looks brighter after each use, and it hasn't caused any irritation, which is a big plus for my sensitive skin. The apple scent is also a nice touch, making my skincare routine feel a bit more luxurious.

I've been using the YOUTHTOPIA™ Liquid Exfoliating Apple Face Peel by Origins for a few weeks, and I'm thoroughly impressed. The sleek packaging and refreshing apple scent make it a pleasure to use. It's easy to apply, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave a sticky residue. My skin feels smoother and looks visibly brighter from the first use, with a significant reduction in pores and a more even skin tone. It's gentle enough for sensitive skin, with no irritation, thanks to the high-quality natural ingredients like apple extract. While it's a bit pricey, a little goes a long way, making it a worthwhile investment. Overall, I highly recommend it for those seeking an effective exfoliating solution.

Wow this is such a good peel! I use a chemical exfoliant everyday and this has become my new favorite! It feels so nice on your skin and doesn't make it feel irritated like most other products like this! Highly recommend!

avis.titre: I'm enjoying it….except for the scent
avis.texte: I enjoy this toner! The scent is stronger than I normally like but it is effective in a gentle way. A milky substance with an apple cider scent, it leaves my skin bright and pores clear. I particularly use it on those days I don't use my tretinoin.

I initially thought this would be a proper peeling. But the description - use it daily with a cotton pad - make it sound more like a toner. I love the fruity smell and how easy the liquid is to apply. Having consistently used it every night for over two weeks, my skin feels smoother and looks more balanced.

Youthtopia Liquid Exfoliating Apple Face Peel is a game-changer. The sleek bottle and pleasant apple scent add to its appeal. With effective AHAs and BHAs, it gently exfoliates, leaving skin smooth and radiant. Noticeable improvements in texture after a few uses.

I found this Youthtopia Exfoliating Apple Face Peel from Origins to be gentle and effective. It was easy and pleasant to use and after a few weeks, I started to notice an improvement to my overall skin. I love when products perform as described and this one did just that. I will recommend and I will definitely keep it in my rotation.

The confidence boost from achieving a smoother, even complexion is PRICELESS! The formulation has been amazing! I have sensitive skin, and the product never once caused irritation, and it doesn't feel dry or tight on my skin.I saw a visible reduction in the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles and my skin texture has been improving the more I use it. My skin also looks very radiant and glowing . Very happy with the results !

I really like this product, I feel I do need to use it a bit longer but so far it makes my skin feel refreshed and it has a very slight fragrance but it smells very good and fresh, like apples! lol!!!

I am loving this peel so far. It has a milky consistency and a nice apple scent. My skin feels smoother and looks brighter in the mornings after using it at night with a cotton pad. Will definitely continue to use!

I'm not sure if this liquid exfoliant works for me and I'm going to be 100% honest I can't stand the fragrance because is way too strong... I wanted to love it but I couldn't sleep with the strong fragrance. The product doesn't feel sticky at all and I didn't notice any skin reactions so it might work for others I just don't like the strong fragrance.

I was a bit hesitant at first because I have sensitive skin and was worried this would be too strong. I started off every other day and noticed immediately after how much more radiant my skin looked and how smooth my skin felt over time with use. I'm not a fan of the bottle packaging as it tends to over pour no matter how much I try to be careful and some would spill over on the side of it. So it can be a little messy but the product does work!

This youthtopia refining apple peel feels like a milky toner and the scent is refreshing. It does a great job hydrating and plumping the skin. I use a cotton pad or my hands for application and both work the same. if you want to save some product then opt for your hands.

This youthtopia liquid exfoliator from origins is really great! even though it has an apple scent it does not break my skin out one bit and leaves it feeling soft and glowy! i really enjoy using this product!

I love iiiiiitt!! The essence is so good! The Apple odor is very good… the packaking is great, for easy application , good texture very smoothie smells so good i recommended this for everyone ! My skin now is beatiful

I have sensitive skin and this is absolutely gentle enough for daily use. It feels so light and refreshing, almost like a toner (but smells way better). My face has felt softer and is gradually getting a bit smoother since I introduced this peel to my routine. I think the word "peel" makes it sound a bit more harsh than it actually is. If you are like me and looking for something that gives a gentle but effective exfoliation, and is good for daily maintenance, this is it.

avis.titre: Give me all the stem cells!
avis.texte: I get closed comedones all over my cheeks and jaw lines and struggle to keep the texture of my skin smooth. I really like this exfoliant my skin turns over quickly and am left with smoother skin in just 2 days. The apple stem cells are such a good ingredient that help to make the skin look younger and plumper. I recommend using stem cells in your skincare routine it has transformed my skin.

I am a big fan of toner or anything that evens out your skin tone. So I was really excited to try out this new product. It seems gentle and it's easy to just apply with a cotton pad. I would definitely recommend adding sunscreen while using this product.

Been enjoying using this Apple peal. First it smells so good. I have dry sensitive skin and this peel didn't irritate my skin. I love using it at night and I wake up with a glowy and hydrated skin. Highly recommended for great results.

I love how convenient this exfoliator is. The fact that I don't have to do any hard scrub or rinse my face after is great! If you have sensitive skin please for your sake do a patch test to make sure that you can handle it.

As someone with sensitive skin I'm always nervous to try peels but this was surprisingly such a great experience each time I tried it. It smells really fresh and it didn't irritate my skin. It's pretty gentle and I had no reactions to it. I've been using this 1-2 times per week and it leaves my skin feeling very soft and renewed. This does a really great job brightening my skin. This is a really nice product if you want to get rid of dullness!

avis.titre: Want better looking skin?! This is it!
avis.texte: What an amazing texture and settle scent this product has! My skin is super soft and reduces the look of my pores. Love that after using this exfoliant my skin is hydrated and plump. It's safe for acne prone skin like mine!🤍

My skin is dry and sensitive. I use this product a few times a week without any reaction, it is not aggressive. Just as promised, the skin looks softer and brighter. Such a noticeable difference, and it also doesn't irritate my skin or feel painful when applied.

I've been loving this Origins YOUTHTOPIA, refining apple peel. Just when I think there's no residual left on my face this gets the rest. It leaves my face glowing after. The consistency is light but looks milky. I haven't had any adverse effects or tingling either. It feels gentle on my skin. There is a very light vinegar smell to it but that doesn't bother me. Los of good stuff in this! I will say the only slight con, is that it stays slightly tacky until it completely dries. It's definitely a must have. Instant glow since my first use. I don't use a product like this everyday but I will use every other day.

I've been using this product and so far I'm really liking it. My skin is oily and tends to break out in acne easily, but this product has exfoliated gently without causing any damage. My skin feels radiant, and I'm enjoying it.

This is a great peel that exfoliates my skin but is also hydrating. I love the extra boost of hydration it gives my skin. I use this in the evening and my skin looks radiant and glowing in the morning. I'll always keep this in my rotation!

First off, who doesn't love apples? This peel smells amazing and leaves skin glowing! Finally a product that is helping with the redness I get in my tzone, cheeks. The different elements of the peel work seamlessly with my skin. I cannot wait to keep seeing results with continued use.

I absolutely love this face peel! The fact it is vegan and silicone free made me fall in love before I even tried it. I personally use it once a week and it leaves my pores looking smaller and my skin looking radiant. I've noticed my makeup applying smoother as well!

Bottle is a bit small for price. The product itself works well. Using a cotton pad, just going over the skin it picks up left over dead skin and any dirt, and you can clearly see it on the cotton pad. Product itself after frequent use brightens skin. Like my dark spots and acne lessened, giving the skin a tighter and just brighter look. I say the results are great but the price and how much you could get is steep.

I absolutely love this product not only does it clears my pores. It makes my face nice and tight pretty comfortable on the skin and it's really lightweight and a little bit goes a long way. I would definitely recommend checking this product out.

My skin is absolutely loving this. It smells great to start with. I did it experience any irritation on my skin. I did use it was a pad as instructed and it was very hydrating to the skin. I have dry skin and I really enjoyed it.

i love this product. it is a great face peel and i like how it is apple scented. i love all other skincare products by this brand so i knew i would like this one. i apply it at night before bed, love it!

I love this moisturizer especially after I pair it with the peel. This moisturizer makes my face feel so soft and bouncy. I love how it doesn't make any sunscreen pill after I apply it too. The smell is also amazing!!

Really great exfoliant! The smell is super yummy like fresh apples! The packaging is super cute as well! The product itself feels nourishing and gentle compared to other exfoliants! Definitely recommend trying!!

Surprisingly gentle for the dramatic results this gives! My skin is notoriously sensitive to exfoliation treatments & I noticed brightening but no redness or irritation. My skin felt smoother after just the first use. I was surprised it had such a milky look and hydrating feel—definitely not your typical peel.

This peel made my skin feel thoroughly cleansed with oily spots targeted. However, the product was not factory-sealed in any way when I received it, and there were very limited instructions on the packaging for use (mostly just saying to wear sunscreen while using). I'm still not sure how many times a week this is safe to use, or if it can be used like a daily toner - I've been trying it 1-2x weekly. Overall, I appreciate the natural ingredients and apple scent of this peel.

This is such an interesting product, I was so excited to try it! I've had great results so far after using it for a couple weeks. I dab a little on a cotton round and swipe it over my face after cleansing. It has a lightweight, milky texture and a muted apple cider vinegar scent (I don't let the scent bother me, especially if the product is effective!) My skin feels instantly hydrated, and in the morning I wake up with smooth, radiant skin. I do wish it had a flip top instead of one that needs to twist off, but that doesn't take away from the product. I highly recommend this one!

Oh my! This exfoliating apple peel smells so good! It's such pleasure to use it. I apply it each morning and my dry 36yo skin looks and feels so good. Great product and i will definitely keep buying it.

avis.titre: So gentle, it made my skin so soft!
avis.texte: I use this daily in place of toner. It is so gentle and truly effective. With just a few uses my skin now looks less textured, more refined and brighter. Origins never fails to deliver! This formula is so milky, lightly hydrating and I love how it smells. It's a very unique natural scent.
wow, honestly I have to say that I loved this product, I liked it so much, it's so gentle on the skin that it doesn't feel like a peeling at all. It left my skin very soft and glowing

This refining apple peel is nice. The texture is not thick but thicker than a serum. It smells faintly sweet of apples I'm happy it doesn't smell vinegary . After I've had it on my skin feels so soft. It absorbs into my skin . Very nice gentle peel.

This gentle vegan formula Apple Stem Cells exfoliating liquid face peel is really a nice one! It smells quite nice and feels very pleasing. It has a very smooth texture with a watery-like consistency. I use a cotton pad and apply a decent amount of the liquid peel on it, then gently wiping it all over my clean face, making sure that the liquid is evenly distributed. I love how comfortable and gentle it feels on the skin. There's no reaction from redness or irritation after using this peel. I feel my skin looks a lot smoother and softer. The rough texture of my skin appears more even as the peel helps removing away dead skin cells on my skin. By using this Refining Apple Peel a couple times a week, I can visibly see big improvement in the texture, pores and tone of my skin. My rather enlarged pores look more refined, clearer and less clogging resulting in a brighter and smoother complexion.

I enjoyed trying out this product. I am using this for preventative anti aging measures as I am in my mid twenties. I appreciate how the ingredients are natural and it doesn't irritate my normally very sensitive skin.

the peel had a good way of freshening up the skin. after trying out a few times i saw the texture of my skin minimizing and my pores looked smaller my skin has a new bright glow. i love the smell of the product.

This is a creamy liquid that applies to your clean skin. It has a nice apple scent and is great with any skin type. I've been using it nightly and definitely helps to create a smooth and radiant finish with continued use.

I am in love with the texture and pleasant apple scent, my skin is very sensitive for new products but this product is perfect for me! Such a pleasant glow and velvety skin after use. The packaging is quite large, looks very stylish😍😍😍

I'm loving this liquid exfoliating Apple face peel!!! It refreshes my skin without stripping it and leaves my skin even-toned and glowing! I love how it clarifies and reduces the appearance of pores -10/10!

I love this apple face peel! I am unsure if I am using it correctly though. It is smooth and light and also smells great! It's in a unique bottle too. I do use it with my other skincare. If anyone has any tips that'd be great!

This Apple face peel is a great product to use once a week! I haven't notice any issues with irritation or anything else it was gentle on my skin and I like the fact that it's easy to use and the packaging is amazing

This product is really nice! It smells amazing and helped my skin feel smooth and hydrated. It is a very gentle toner and did not cause any irritation. Very easy to use and it lasts a long time. My skin has been very clean!

I recently tried the YOUTHTOPIA Liquid Exfoliating Apple Face Peel. It is amazing. It removed all the excess dirt and oil from my face. It made my skin feel so smooth and soft after use. It is very easy to use. It Hydrates the skin.

This is gentle exfoliate that I use at night and when I wake up in the morning my skin is noticeably bright and smooth. It does not feel harsh and after a few weeks I haven't had any bad reactions or dryness and my barrier feels in tact.

This liquid exfoliant is great. It leaves my skin feeling so soft and refreshed. It's lightweight and doesn't break my skin. Not greasy. Melts right into my skin. It smells pretty good too. I will be using this daily!

Has a very milky texture and is very easy to use! The cap is designed to be twist on. It also a really nice citrus scent. The scent is not overwhelming and is very subtle. This liquid is also very gentle and works great for all skin types.

I have really liked this product so far. It's not too harsh and as someone with oily and acne prone skin I have been searching for a good peel. It smells quite lovely and not like strong chemicals. This review was Incentivized.

The YOUTHTOPIA™ Liquid Exfoliating Apple Face Peel by Origins US is a fantastic addition to my skincare routine. After just a few uses, my skin feels noticeably smoother and looks brighter. It's gentle yet effective, and the apple scent is refreshing. Highly recommended for a quick skin refresh!

I love this peel! It has really improved my skin texture since I got it. It's not too harsh on my skin, but strong enough to pull off that dead layer of skin that I needed to get rid of. Smells nice too!

This face peel is gentle but effective. I noticed a difference after the first use. My skin was softer and brighter! Face peels/ exfoliates sometimes have a weird smell but this one just smells like apples.

I really liked this facial peel. The use of apple peels makes it natural but also powerful! I noticed my skin looking brighter after using it and I'm excited to keep incorporating it into my skincare routine!

The Exfoliating Apple Face Peel is such a gentle liquid face peel. It has a milky texture and feels great on the skin. I love that it 97% naturally derived and doesn't contain questionable ingredients. When applied, it doesn't sting unless there's an open wound and even then has a manageable effect. It definitely makes my face look more radiant and my skin felt smoother. I definitely love using this daily because it feels so good on the skin.

avis.titre: Moisturizing + infused with my fav ingredient: ACV
avis.texte: My first time using Origins products, and I'm impressed! I'm always a fan of skincare with food-based ingredients, and the Origins Youthtopia Apple Peel doesn't disappoint. It contains apple cider vinegar (ACV), apple peel ferment, and apple stem cell extract. Despite being an exfoliant, there's absolutely no sting, making it perfect for my super dry skin. I used it before applying my daily tinted serum foundation, and it made my skin incredibly smooth. Highly recommend for anyone with dry skin looking for gentle yet effective exfoliation.

avis.titre: Gentle exfoliating milk with sweet scent
avis.texte: Origins refining apple peel is a gentle chemical exfoliant, so there's no grit, just mild acids to help resurface skin. It smells super sweet like candy and looks milky with a slight pulpiness. I apply it with a cotton pad and leave it on, following up with a serum and moisturizer after it dries down. I wish the instructions were more robust, but it seems to be working well the way I'm using it.

I enjoyed this cute bottle! I adore the scent, very apples like but not annoying. It felt so hydrating on my skin and gave a nice doze of glow. It is so gentle on the skin and I was able to use it every day. My skin looked smoother and more even toned after about a week of use.

I started using the YOUTHTOPIA Liquid Exfoliating Apple Face Peel and I am enjoying it. The thinner consistency of the outside was a pleasant surprise. My skin can become sensitive to certain products but that was not the case with this product. I highly recommend.

I was really impressed by this exfoliant. I have dry skin so I limit my chemical exfoliant use to about twice a week. I used this in the evening, after cleansing and toning but before my moisturizer. I applied with a cotton round. I did not find this product irritating or harsh at all. My skin actually looked very dewy after applying and felt hydrated. It contains so many great ingredients and I love that the formulation is vegan. It does have a strong scent—apple, of course—but I really liked it. I found it refreshing! I would definitely recommend this one!

I think this is the first time I tried a liquid exfoliating that makes my skin soft and smooth after applying it. I tried other brands but it just feels like water, with this one I could notice a difference on the first try. My skin feels hydrated, with a glow, and soft after using it. I was concerned about the fragrance of it, but to my surprise it has kind of a sweet scent which doesn't bother me.

Absolutely love the scent of this product, it's perfect without being too strong. Since starting to use this product my skin has been looking and feeling smoother. Love how it hasn't dried out my skin or made my skin break out!

I have been using Origins for over six years, it always work wonders in my combination skin. I feel the products have formulation that are not to harsh on the skin but also effective, I love the clean ingredients! This exfoliate in particular it's very gentle but after using for a week my skin looks brighter and smoother!

YOUTHTOPIA Liquid Exfoliating Apple Face Peel I'm very impressed! The smell is very gentle, which I like the most. I love that it has very nice ingredients. It has a milky consistency and a smooth texture. The product easily applies to my skin, leaving it radiant. After application, my face feels smooth and soft. It gives my skin a nice look with a touch of hydration. I like that it doesn't cause any irritation and also adds moisture. Additionally, the YOUTHTOPIA Liquid Exfoliating Apple Face Peel effectively exfoliates without being harsh on the skin, making it suitable for regular use. The gentle formula is ideal for those with sensitive skin, ensuring a comfortable and refreshing experience. I like that it helps improve in my skin's texture and overall appearance, with a brighter and more even complexion. This product has become a staple in my skincare routine, providing both exfoliation and hydration in one easy step.

Youthtopia liquid exfoliating is fairly new to me. I love liquid / chemical exfoliation because it reveals that healthy bright skin underneath. This particular one is gentle for daily use and I see a visible difference.

This Liquid Exfoliating Apple Face Peel works wonders for my combination to dry and mature skin. I love how gentle it is for my skin. It does not cause any dryness or irritation. I apply it onto my skin with a cotton pad and since using this peel my skin is feeling softer and smoother. The texture of my skin has improved, and my skin tone is more even.
